# Data Munging with Perl

> Second edition of Dave Cross's practical guide to data recognition, parsing,
> transformation and filtering in Perl. Available as a work-in-progress
> edition (currently around 65% complete) on Leanpub, with free updates as
> new chapters land.

## Links
- [Buy on Leanpub](https://leanpub.com/datamungingwithperl)
- [Author: Dave Cross](https://davecross.co.uk/)
- [Perl Hacks blog](https://perlhacks.com/)
